verdict.rationale: The evidence documents GitHub Actions for automating and executing workflows in a repository, but nothing in the pack describes recurring or scheduled triggers such as cron or time-based schedules. Automated or one-off workflow execution is not the same as a recurring schedule, and the community mention of 'scheduled reminders' covers notifications, not jobs or workflows. So no documented recurring-job capability is shown.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
